decisions.decision: Use plain-Java executable contract tests
decisions.rationale: The approved dependency set contains no test framework; assertion-based test mains exercise behavior without expanding the dependency surface.

decisions.decision: Keep compiler provenance outside business records
decisions.rationale: Source locations and Java owner/member hints are required for instrumentation, but business graphs retain only opaque IDs and business labels.

decisions.decision: Correlate dispatch at implementation entry
decisions.rationale: Candidate implementation entries emit the precomputed opaque edge ID while an active graph context verifies that the edge belongs to it.

decisions.decision: Use the fully source-visible journey-warning manager as the polymorphic Mega proof
decisions.rationale: It exercises three real brownfield strategies without pretending binary-only dependency logic is understood.

decisions.decision: Bind runtime predicate probes to developer-only source lines
decisions.rationale: Sequence-only bytecode matching could attribute unrelated conditional jumps as business reasons.

decisions.decision: Interleave baseline and enabled load windows
decisions.rationale: Adjacent windows preserve workload totals while controlling phase-order machine drift in p95 comparison.

decisions.decision: Share visited-edge resolution between PlantUML and Mermaid
decisions.rationale: Both persisted formats must highlight exactly the same observed execution path.

decisions.decision: Reuse one Stop node with multiple outcome probes
decisions.rationale: The static business topology stays simple while each compiled return site still records the typed result.

decisions.decision: Translate result-relevant null checks to absence semantics
decisions.rationale: Optionality can explain a decision, but Java null syntax and identifier suffixes are implementation details.

decisions.decision: Use Maven as the source and classpath adapter
decisions.rationale: The build already owns accurate module source roots and dependency resolution, eliminating manual launcher setup.

decisions.decision: Offer one-off and lifecycle Maven invocation modes
decisions.rationale: Full coordinates minimize first-use configuration while a plugin execution supports concise repeat builds.

decisions.decision: Create exact branch metadata only for complete Boolean topology
decisions.rationale: Incomplete or ambiguous graph data must use the safe legacy probe.

decisions.decision: Emit exact edges from branch trampolines
decisions.rationale: The branch site knows which precomputed graph continuation the application selected.

decisions.decision: Complete failures at one entry-boundary handler
decisions.rationale: One catch-all handler records explicit and propagated failures once and rethrows the same object.

decisions.decision: Accept explicit diagram edges only from the observed node
decisions.rationale: Invalid evidence must not select or infer a business route.

decisions.decision: Bind short-circuit jumps by method occurrence and completion mode
decisions.rationale: A runtime edge is emitted only when an atomic jump determines the full predicate result.

decisions.decision: Require all-or-none exact plans
decisions.rationale: Partial compound metadata must not mix exact and inferred evidence.

decisions.decision: Pre-index registered graph edges
decisions.rationale: Application-thread edge validation must remain constant-time as static graphs grow.

decisions.decision: Use source lines only to anchor the first predicate-group jump
decisions.rationale: Java 21 javac can assign the group line or operand line to continuation jumps.

decisions.decision: Use legacy probes for ambiguous predicate forms
decisions.rationale: Mixed, nested, ternary, switch-expression, and ambiguous lambda bytecode must not be presented as exact evidence.

decisions.decision: Verify every analysis fingerprint before export
decisions.rationale: A clean repository can move to another commit after analysis. The check proves that the exported commit still contains the analyzed source.

decisions.decision: Use the complete Maven parameter pair as the JSON enablement signal
decisions.rationale: Existing diagram builds stay Git-free, while configured builds cannot silently omit revision data.

decisions.decision: Verify each source blob at the captured commit
decisions.rationale: Clean Git status does not include ignored generated files, so blob verification is required for an exact source link.

decisions.decision: Namespace execution IDs per collector process
decisions.rationale: A UUID namespace plus a local sequence prevents restarts from reusing an execution ID while keeping generation independent of storage.

decisions.decision: Represent an unconfirmed save as unknown
decisions.rationale: Java interruption cannot prove that an uncooperative storage operation did not commit, so unknown is more accurate than dropped and stops further detached calls.

decisions.decision: Bind runtime probes with JVM descriptors
decisions.rationale: Owner and method name do not identify an overload. The descriptor also lets the transformer resolve only the lambda targets of the correct enclosing overload.

decisions.decision: Select compiler mode from the graph-entry project
decisions.rationale: A mixed reactor is not one synthetic named module set. Flat entries and named-module entries need separate valid compiler contexts.

decisions.decision: Lower compound Boolean expressions to atomic graph nodes
decisions.rationale: Exact runtime paths require one edge per evaluated business fact, including short-circuit skips.

decisions.decision: Use source artifacts before a fail-closed ASM fallback
decisions.rationale: Source keeps business vocabulary and semantics; bytecode is safe only in a small proven subset.

decisions.decision: Inject async wrappers at application call sites
decisions.rationale: This avoids bootstrap instrumentation and removes manual wrapping for standard APIs.

decisions.decision: Make module ownership an explicit source input
decisions.rationale: A file path alone cannot be assigned safely to a named or automatic module.

decisions.decision: Test JDBC against PostgreSQL without a production driver dependency
decisions.rationale: A test-scope driver proves production database behavior while the adapter stays vendor-neutral.

decisions.decision: Retain each proven atomic path and add a gap for each unproven atom
decisions.rationale: Exact evidence stays useful, but the runtime never infers an edge for an atom that bytecode correlation cannot prove.

decisions.decision: Model structured exits before graph projection
decisions.rationale: Normal, return, throw, catch, and finally effects need one control-flow model before business-only rendering.

decisions.decision: Select dynamic targets only from static candidates with runtime evidence
decisions.rationale: A proxy, provider, or reflected member can select known logic, but an unknown or ambiguous target must stay a gap.

decisions.decision: Limit bytecode extraction to fingerprinted side-effect-free methods
decisions.rationale: A small ASM subset can prove result-relevant binary logic without exposing bytecode vocabulary or claiming unsupported behavior.

decisions.decision: Keep the production JDBC adapter driver-neutral
decisions.rationale: PostgreSQL proof uses a test-scope driver and an explicit integration command, while applications continue to supply a standard data source.

decisions.decision: Capture release producer output before presentation
decisions.rationale: A separate temporary output capture preserves the producer status and still lets tee create readable evidence without hiding a failure.

decisions.decision: Bind typed evidence to proven predicate operands
decisions.rationale: A static evidence plan records only a result-relevant fact at the node that uses it and prevents blanket annotated-method argument capture.

decisions.decision: Give each async reservation one atomic lifecycle
decisions.rationale: Reserved, running, and released states make execution, rejection, and cancellation before start release the invocation exactly once.

decisions.decision: Identify standard async callbacks by exact JVM signature
decisions.rationale: Owner, method, descriptor, and callback position prevent the transformer from wrapping a preceding stage, executor, or thread group.

decisions.decision: Lower indexed collection loops before business projection
decisions.rationale: Recognizing the canonical iteration shape keeps body decisions but removes counters, collection size checks, indexed access, and ordinal candidates.

decisions.decision: Resolve one Maven repository path for all verification scripts
decisions.rationale: Manual Java classpaths must use the same repository that Maven populated in local and clean release runs.

decisions.decision: Let Maven build transitive verification classpaths
decisions.rationale: Resolved classpaths prevent a warm home cache from hiding stale pinned transitive versions such as SLF4J.
